aboutPreview.heading: Deeper Understanding. Better Solutions.
aboutPreview.body: ICL is a dynamic holding company that provides customized strategies, innovative solutions, and comprehensive support to meet diverse business demands. Our practice spans Transportation Solutions, Logistics Services, Business Development, Executive Hospitality, and Professional Corporate Services.
aboutPreview.quote: We work with fierce resolve to build a group that our clients, partners, employees, and communities take pride in.

chairman.title: Building the Future Through Human Capital & Innovation
chairman.p1: Welcome to ICL. Our approach to sustainable growth and corporate development rests on a fundamental principle: human capital first, powered by continuous innovation as the framework for long-term progress.
chairman.p2: We are expanding our capabilities to set new benchmarks across regional logistics, aviation, hospitality, and corporate support, deploying our highest qualifications to deliver lasting value.

vision.title: Customer-Centered Excellence
items: Treat clients with the highest standard of empathy and integrity.
Provide tailored, comprehensive portfolios that match complex corporate needs.
Champion client interests with proactive advocacy and transparent communication.
Prioritize long-term client trust over transient short-term gains.

mission.title: Global Reach, Local Execution
mission.text: We empower businesses, institutions, and communities to seize contemporary economic opportunities through robust infrastructure, localized expertise, and uncompromising service standards.

professional.title: Professional Services
professional.description: Comprehensive corporate risk mitigation, documentation verification, and talent recruitment.
professional.body: Our complete background check and document verification solutions minimize operational risk and facilitate regulatory compliance across international markets.
professional.bgChecksDesc: Minimize corporate and counterparty risk with automated background checks for companies, partners, and vendors.
professional.verificationDesc: Direct government-sourced verification for corporate identity, incorporation records, and commercial credentials with full consent protection.
professional.vendorDesc: Automate counterparty risk analysis, verify supplier credentials, and ensure regulatory alignment.
professional.recruitmentDesc: Talent sourcing and specialized staffing tailored to specialized corporate roles across Libya and the region.

hospitality.title: Hospitality Services
hospitality.description: Oyster Guest House — An exclusive executive residency overlooking Tripoli Port.
hospitality.body: Oyster Guest House is a 680 m² luxury property with 530 m² of executive living space located in the prestigious Bouseta district near Al-Quba Al-Falakia.
hospitality.propertyDetails: The ground floor features a welcoming reception, executive lounge, co-working hub, and coffee bar. The upper levels house the Pearl Apartment (60 m²) and Sadafa Apartment (65 m²), crowned by a scenic rooftop garden, open-air fitness gym, and terrace.

about.title: About ICL Group
about.subtitle: International Coverage Logistics
about.intro: Established in 2014 in Tripoli, Libya, ICL is a multidisciplinary holding company committed to operational excellence across logistics, private aviation, hospitality, and corporate services.
about.commitment: We work closely with international partners, regional institutions, and commercial clients to execute complex ventures with dependability and strategic vision.
about.chairmanSpeech: Our growth is anchored in a steadfast belief: human talent and relentless innovation are the catalysts for sustainable economic development.
visionItems: Deliver client-first service across every division and subsidiary.
Provide integrated multi-industry solutions under one holding entity.
Maintain the highest standards of corporate transparency and safety.
Foster long-term relationships that generate lasting community value.
about.mission: To be the premier corporate holding gateway connecting Libyan enterprise with global supply chains, modern aviation, and cutting-edge business solutions.
